# Beyond Fluency Lab

Live communication coaching from Learn With Smile: ten programme families, fourteen delivery options. Small live classes and premium personalised private coaching for life, study and work. All prices are indicative in EUR; timetable, coach, applicable taxes and final total are confirmed before enrolment.
